source.quality: 1080P 高码率, highest offered official source

exclusions.description: Background foliage/fog, alpha boundaries and occlusion; not certified solid surface
Moving performer conservative ROI, includes background, not precise segmentation

mask_classes.1: Moving performer conservative ROI, includes background, not precise segmentation
mask_classes.2: Dynamic water/reflection or reflected forest; not reliable solid geometry
mask_classes.3: Background foliage/fog, alpha boundaries and occlusion; not certified solid surface
mask_classes.4: Dark continuous inverted island underside silhouette; material and local shape unresolved, NOT empty roots or absence of surface

scene_cautions: Conservative incomplete manual ROIs, unlabelled does not imply valid
Dark continuous underside does not imply void; bright canopy is not floor
Water reflections and screen overlap cannot establish contact
Native4K is not raw4K depth; raw grid924x518
No absolute distance, hidden geometry or motion inference; no later-date replay verification

value_definition: Relative inverse-depth-like prediction: larger/white generally nearer, smaller/black generally farther. Not metric distance or ordinary image luminance. Per-image normalized numbers cannot be compared as distance across images.
normalization: (raw-min)/(max-min); source-grid output is explicitly derived bicubic interpolation align_corners=False, not native-resolution independent prediction.

masks.manual_exclusions: Conservative incomplete manually inspected ROIs, later drawn classes overwrite overlap, 0 unlabelled NOT certified valid. Performer ROIs drawn last to preserve performer caution in overlaps.
masks.confidence_unknown: 255 everywhere means NO calibrated confidence, NEVER high confidence.
masks.nonfinite: 255 nonfinite numerical output; 0 merely finite, NOT geometry validity.
masks.dark_low_signal: 255 where all original RGB channels <= threshold (default25), heuristic low-signal caution only; this brightness mask is NOT the depth algorithm.
masks.occluded_hidden: Unobserved hidden surfaces cannot be inferred as fact.

limitations: Single monocular depth is not metric geometry, scale, contact or camera calibration
Stylized CG, character motion, reflections, transparency, shadows and light can invalidate predictions
No replacement for native multiview references and direct unwarped overlays
